title: Coven automation run (coven.automations.run.v1)
description: One row of the run ledger: every claimed occurrence that reaches a runtime. Coven owns the record; it is the single observability surface clients read.

status.description: running is the only non-terminal state; terminal transitions are monotonic and a second finish is a no-op.

logJson.description: Bounded run log; entries beyond 65536 characters are truncated. Logs must never carry prompt text, credentials, or private memory.

outputCommit.description: Delivery state of the atomic output target.

ambiguous.description: True when the runtime outcome was lost after a possible side effect: the run must not read as succeeded, and only an explicit operator reconcile may resolve it.

adoptionKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key for manual commands; one adoption key fences exactly one run.
